name: fakereum-worker
description: Fakereum — a forked-EVM JSON-RPC sandbox that fronts any EVM RPC, ported to a Cloudflare Worker (free-plan compatible).

scripts.deploy: sh -c 'exec npx wrangler deploy --env "${1:?usage: npm run deploy -- <chainid>}"' --
scripts.deploy:secrets: sh -c 'exec npx wrangler deploy --env "${1:?usage: npm run deploy:secrets -- <chainid>}" --secrets-file ".prod.vars.$1"' --
scripts.deploy:pages: sh -c 'exec npx wrangler pages deploy --cwd "pages/${1:?usage: npm run deploy:pages -- <chainid>}" --branch main --commit-dirty=true' --
